text: Orama performs vector search natively as a vector database
quote: Being a vector database, Orama allows you to perform vector search natively.

text: Hybrid search combines full-text and vector search in a single query and merges the results
quote: Hybrid search is an Orama feature that allows you to perform full-text and vector search in one unique query, combining the results to get the best of both worlds.

text: Supports full-text, vector, hybrid, and AI-powered natural-language search
quote: Full-text search - Vector search - Hybrid search - AI-powered NLP search

text: Faceted search API lets users filter results by category, price range, or other attributes
quote: With the Orama Faceted Search API, users can filter their search results by various criteria, such as category, price range, or other attributes

text: Search filters for narrowing results
quote: Search Filters ... Geosearch

text: Geosearch support
quote: Geosearch

text: Pinning rules for merchandising specific results
quote: Pinning Rules (Merchandising)

text: Typo-tolerant search
quote: Typo Tolerance

text: Field boosting, exact match, and BM25 ranking options
quote: Pinning Rules (Merchandising) ... Fields Boosting ... Typo Tolerance ... Exact Match ... BM25 ... Stemming and tokenization in 30 languages

text: Stemming and tokenization in 30 languages
quote: Stemming and tokenization in 30 languages

text: AnswerSession provides ChatGPT-like conversational answer experiences on your website
quote: we introduced a new feature called **AnswerSession** that allows you to perform ChatGPT-like experiences on your website.

text: Turns a question into a direct answer and shows the sources behind it
quote: turns a question into a straight answer with the sources behind it

text: Secure Proxy routes queries to the OpenAI API so the API key is not exposed client-side
quote: AnswerSession** that allows you to perform ChatGPT-like experiences on your website. It uses a free feature from Orama Cloud called **Secure Proxy** to proxy your queries to the OpenAI API, so you don't need to worry about sharing the API k

text: AnswerSession emits state-change events so the UI can update reactively
quote: The `onStateChange: console.log` event will log the state of the session, allowing you to reactively update your UI based on the current state of the session.

text: Embeddings plugin generates embeddings at insert and search time for vector and hybrid search
quote: This plugin generates embeddings for your documents at insert and search time, allowing you to perform vector and hybrid searches on your documents.

text: Embeddings plugin converts text to vectors without exposing your OpenAI API key in the front-end
quote: The plugin will automatically convert this text to vector for you, and will also prevent you from exposing your OpenAI API key when using it on the front-end.

text: Orama Cloud automatically generates text embeddings using local, high-quality models
quote: Orama Cloud generates text embeddings automatically for your data using local, high-quality models.

text: Choose a collection's language and embedding model when you create it
quote: When you create a collection, you can choose its language (English, Spanish, etc.), and the embedding model you want to use.

text: Open-source search library you can add to your own application at no cost
quote: The open-source search library. Add fast, relevant search to your own application at no cost.

text: On-premise support for deploying the Orama Cloud context server on your own infrastructure
quote: We offer on-premise support for Orama Cloud, allowing you to deploy the context server on your own infrastructure.

text: Every Orama Cloud project includes an auto-configured MCP server for AI interfaces like ChatGPT and Cursor
quote: Every Orama Cloud project comes with an MCP server that is automatically configured to interact with your project's data.

text: Orama Cloud lets you choose the search algorithm that best suits your needs
quote: Orama Cloud gives you the flexibility to choose the search algorithm that best suits your needs.

text: Data sources are segregated, so you can update, add, or delete data in one without affecting others
quote: Every data source is segregated from the others, so you can update, delete, or add new data without affecting the data in the other data sources.

text: Projects group data sources for RAG, search, or other retrieval methods
quote: A project is a set of **data sources** that you want to use for RAG, search, or any other method of retrieval.

text: Official Orama Cloud SDKs for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Rust
quote: Orama Cloud officially supports the following SDKs: - JavaScript/TypeScript - Python - Rust

text: Open-source APIs mirror Orama Cloud APIs, so projects can migrate in either direction
quote: The APIs are designed to be as close as possible to the **Orama Cloud** APIs, so you can easily migrate your projects from **Orama Cloud** to **Orama Open Source** and vice-versa.

text: Native support for nested document properties
quote: Orama supports nested properties natively. Just add them as you would typically do in any JavaScript object

text: Create a database from an indexing schema that defines the searchable properties
quote: We can create a new instance (from now on database) with an **indexing `schema`**. The schema represents **the searchable properties** of the document to be inserted.

text: Schema supports multiple typed field types such as string
Schema validation rejects unexpected types and allows missing or extra fields
quote: throw an error if a field has an unexpected type - allow missing fields or fields set to `undefined` - allow extra fields ignoring them

text: insertMultiple bulk-inserts large numbers of documents without blocking the event loop
quote: Inserting a large number of documents in a loop could potentially block the event loop. Instead `insertMultiple` handles this case better.

text: Orama Cloud is a fully managed service with a simple API and a web interface for running Orama at scale
quote: Orama Cloud is a fully managed service that allows you to run Orama at scale. It is designed to be easy to use, with a simple API and a web interface

text: JavaScript runtime for building agents and custom business logic
quote: A JavaScript runtime that allows your to build agents and custom business logic

text: Assesses data readiness for AI decisions and reports a CIC score from 0 to 10
quote: We assess the data each decision needs, identify the gaps, and show what must improve before a model or agent can reliably support it. The CIC score summarizes that readiness from 0 to 10.

text: Metis trains models on your own data and deploys them in your cloud, on-prem, or on dedicated infrastructure
quote: Metis starts from the return you want, trains models on your own data, and puts them into production. It runs in your cloud, on-prem, or dedicated

text: Installable via npm, yarn, pnpm, or bun
quote: You can install Orama using `npm`, `yarn`, `pnpm`, `bun`
